def list_sets(family='ipv4'):
    """
    .. versionadded:: 2014.7.0

    List all ipset sets.

    CLI Example:

    .. code-block:: bash

        salt '*' ipset.list_sets

    """
    cmd = "ipset list"
    if family:
        cmd += " -{0}".format(family)
    return __salt__["cmd.run"](cmd).splitlines()
